lines: Squawk! Oh, hello there. I'm Penguin. I look after the Cookie Machine's moving parts, ever since the gnu retired.
First, the mixer. It stirs the batter, but it only turns when the motor controller tells it to. No controller, no stirring.
Then the press. It squashes each blob of batter into a thin, flat round. It waits for the conveyor's beat, then thump.
Last, the conveyor. It carries the flat rounds away to the Oven. Press too early and the rounds pile up. Too late and the belt runs empty.
config.nudge: Listen to what Penguin said about the mixer. Which part tells it when to turn?
config.question: The batter is not being stirred. Which part tells the mixer when to turn?
config.speaker: Penguin
